npcs.name: Merrick
npcs.personality: Keeps an eye on the door and a place by the fire.

dialogue.greeting: Come in. There's warmth enough, and a clean cup if you want one.
flavorDialogue: Most nights, a quiet room is all anyone asks for.

npcs.name: Rowan
npcs.personality: A traveller letting the road dry from his boots.

dialogue.greeting: Mind the wet cloak. I've only just come in.
flavorDialogue: I meant to leave at dawn. That was before I found this fire.

npcs.name: Alden
npcs.personality: A craftworker enjoying a rare idle evening.

dialogue.greeting: Pull up a seat. Nothing here needs mending tonight.
flavorDialogue: A sound roof and a warm room. You learn to appreciate both.

npcs.name: Ellis
npcs.personality: Keeps everyday provisions close at hand.

dialogue.greeting: Welcome. What do you need for the road?
flavorDialogue: Dry provisions and sound equipment. There is always a use for both.

npcs.name: Renn
npcs.personality: Sets down a tool to hear what you need.

dialogue.greeting: Come up to the counter. Looking for something sturdy?
flavorDialogue: Take your time. A tool ought to fit the hand that uses it.
dialogue.goodbye: Mind the forge on your way out.

npcs.name: Morgan
npcs.personality: Makes time for visitors between the settlement's daily concerns.

dialogue.greeting: Welcome to the hall. What brings you here?
flavorDialogue: You can usually find someone willing to share news here.
